name: @tmo/le-profile
description: Versioned TMO application profile for provenance-preserving law-enforcement-domain record representation and evaluation.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs mutation/*.test.mjs && npm run coverage && npm run coverage:html && npm run coverage:cobertura
scripts.coverage: npm run build && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='dist/*.js' --test-coverage-lines=95 --test-coverage-branches=85 --test-coverage-functions=85 tests/*.test.mjs mutation/*.test.mjs
